items.name: dsh-vision-fallback
items.summary: Silent vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness: route chat images to a fixed vision model, preserve UI originals, and reuse observations across compaction and restarts.

items.name: dsh-plugin-source
items.summary: DeepSeek Harness plugin: group the Settings plugin list by origin (official/community), show version, upstream repo link and local-dev marker. Read-only, zero network.

items.name: dsh-origin-plugin
items.summary: DSH Origin Plugin: drive Origin scientific plotting from DeepSeek Harness AI chat via MCP. Write data, plot line/scatter/column, export PNG/SVG DeepSeek Harness  Origin

items.name: dsh-wallpaper
items.summary: Persistent wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness with opacity, blur, and a fixed web origin.

items.name: dsh-replay-theater
items.summary: Replay a DeepSeek Harness session at its original token cadence — an in-app playback theater with play/pause/step/speed/seek.

items.name: dsh-full-remote
items.summary: Auditable, token-gated DeepSeek Harness remote gateway: mobile QR access, per-device sessions, Host/Origin rewrite, settings/credentials/directory support.

items.name: dsh-fate-twin-contract
items.summary: Unofficial Fate-inspired Archer × Rin skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — original fan art, light/dark modes, offline and reversible.

items.name: dsh-plugin-product-design
items.summary: Product Design workflow suite for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Desktop): a router plus nine pd-* skills — minimum brief gate, three visual directions, evidence-grounded audits/research, URL cloning, frontend builds with a design-QA gate. Original rewrite of the workflow methodology.

items.name: dsh-vision-router-inline
items.summary: Display companion for dsh-vision-router: square picture button on each original model row

items.name: dsh-fgo-chaldea
items.summary: FGO Chaldea-inspired skin pack for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 5 themes, original generated backdrops, gold trim.
